name: Fhenix
steps: Start from fhenix.io and use only the links on it, including @fhenix on X. The games run on outside hosts such as vercel.app and onrender.com, so open them from Fhenix's own pages.
For credits, open onlyfhens.fhenix.io, connect a wallet and an X account, and do the three required quests. The post and video quests unlock after that.
For shop credits, play one of the listed games with one wallet, then sign in to the shop with that same wallet.
After 21 October, watch @fhenix for the first mainnet apps. Fhenix hasn't published any steps for users yet.
what: Fhenix has no token or airdrop, and says its quest credits buy merch only. Mainnet launches on 21 Oct 2026. What you can do, what is free and the risks.
behind: The site is "published, owned, and operated by FHE Labs Ltd., a company incorporated under the laws of the State of Israel". It names Guy Zyskind as founder and Guy Itzhaki, formerly of Intel, as chief executive. The Block reported in 2023 that "Fhenix has raised $7 million in a seed round led by Multicoin Capital and Collider Ventures." In 2024 Calcalist reported a $15 million Series A led by Hac
costs: Everything here is free to try. Testnet demos need only free test ETH. The shop rules say: "You do not need to pay, deposit, stake, or spend any token or cryptocurrency to participate or to earn Credits." Fhenix Pay, its testnet wallet app, says: "We don't charge fees for using the app." Merch beyond your credits is paid in USDC, plus shipping, and "Prices exclude taxes, customs duties, and import
risks: You must be 18 or older. The terms exclude anyone in or from Cuba, Iran, North Korea, Russia, Syria and Belarus, and anyone on UN, US, EU, UK or Israeli sanctions lists. VPNs are banned: "You may not use a VPN, proxy, false identity, or other technical or deceptive means for the purpose of circumventing geographic, sanctions, eligibility, or access restrictions."
